title: VLMEvalKit: An Open-Source Toolkit for Evaluating Large Multi-Modality Models
reasoning: The paper presents a software toolkit for evaluating Large Multi-Modality Models (LMMs). While it incorporates benchmarks that address 'Multi-Modal Safety' (such as MLLMGuard), it does not specifically focus on or provide a dedicated component for evaluating or benchmarking religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
